name: search-trgm-mode-matches-substring
$comment: FM-30 (trigram search, phase 2): a search index that declares trgm: true accepts mode: "trgm" and matches a case-insensitive SUBSTRING of an indexed field -- 'ATAB' inside 'database' -- which tsquery's lexeme-based default mode cannot match at all. Pins the opt-in wire field and the substring-matching behavior together so a client mirror that forgets to gate on the flag (or forgets the substring semantics) fails this case.
